questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Was the painting stolen by the thief?

options.text: Was the thief not stealing the painting?
Did the thief steal the painting?
Was the painting being stolen by the thief?
Did not the thief steal the painting?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "Did the thief steal the painting?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Past Continuous Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing the Past Continuous Tense from passive to active voice is:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e., the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Did + Subject + V1 + Object? (Active Voice)__
 
• Was/were + Object + V3 + by + Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 __
 
• *Did she play the piano?** *(Active Voice)
 
• *Was the piano played by her?** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'painting'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'thief.' 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• "Piano" is a singular noun, so we must "was" with it.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct Answer__: *"Did the thief steal the painting?"*
